components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default forward action for create, save, send, and open flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #245f73; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.72rem 1rem; font: 600 0.95rem "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.03); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(36, 95, 115, 0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e6d85; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); filter: brightness(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Low-risk action for duplicate, archive, close, and supporting controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #cbd8df; border-radius: 8px; background: #eef3f6; color: #1f3b46; padding: 0.72rem 1rem; font: 600 0.95rem "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e5edf1; border-color: #b7c9d2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #245f73; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #dfe8ed; }

components.name: Rail Action
components.description: Expanded navigation rail action with stronger visual presence.
components.css: .ds-rail-action { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2f6176 0%, #245f73 100%); color: #ffffff; padding: 0.72rem 1rem; font: 700 0.92rem "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(36, 95, 115, 0.18); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-rail-action:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 12px 20px rgba(36, 95, 115, 0.22); } .ds-rail-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a9c4ce; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-action:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; font: 600 0.88rem "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; color: #172026; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #c9d1d8; padding: 0.8rem; background: #ffffff; color: #172026; font: 400 1rem "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #61727a; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #b8c5cc; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #245f73; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(36, 95, 115, 0.16); }

narrative.overview:
Strata is a working product tool, not a brand showcase. The interface should feel like a dependable control room for shaping product architecture: quiet, legible, and ready for sustained task work. The codebase already expresses that through cool slate surfaces, teal action color, restrained plum accents, familiar form controls, and consistent rounded geometry that stays soft without becoming playful.

This system rejects novelty-for-novelty's-sake. It uses light gradients and shadow only to separate work zones, loading states, overlays, and navigation rails. It does not ask the user to admire the UI. It should help them move from project library to brief, workspace, specs, and settings with minimal translation cost.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar sans-serif product typography with a tight hierarchy.
Cool neutral surfaces with teal reserved for action and focus.
Rounded panels and pills that soften density without looking decorative.
Motion used for feedback, reveal, and loading only.
Dense information presented in calm, segmented containers.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only true action color. Plum may support atmosphere or selection, but it must never compete with teal for primary intent.

rules.name: The Cool Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay cool and practical. Do not warm them into beige, cream, or editorial paper tones.

rules.name: The No Performance Typography Rule
rules.body: No display fonts in labels, controls, settings, tables, or data-heavy views. If the user is working, the typography must disappear into the task.

rules.name: The Structural First Rule
rules.body: Borders and background shifts establish layout first. Shadows are a supporting layer, never the primary organizing principle.

rules.name: The State Lift Rule
rules.body: Heavier lift belongs to things the user can act on or things that temporarily sit above the workspace.

dos: Do keep the path to the next action obvious through stable button placement, strong section headers, and compact explanatory copy.
Do use familiar UI patterns and a single sans-serif family for the majority of the product surface.
Do keep interactive targets spacious enough for quick scanning and repeated workflow use.
Do preserve readable contrast with Control Ink (#172026) or Support Ink (#4e5f65) instead of airy low-contrast gray.
Do keep motion short (150ms-250ms) and state-driven: loading, expanding, revealing, or confirming.
donts: Don't create dense walls of text. Break explanation into cards, summaries, lists, or scoped helper copy.
Don't ship cluttered layouts. If a panel cannot explain itself quickly, reduce competing surfaces before adding more decoration.
Don't introduce confusing navigation through custom affordances, inconsistent button styling, or hidden action placement.
Don't use slow loading animations or choreographed page reveals. Loading should reassure, not delay.
Don't add overly complex instructions when a label, helper sentence, or guided empty state would do the job.
Don't add decorative motion that does not communicate state.
Don't use heavy saturated accents on inactive controls, decorative glassmorphism, gradient text, or side-stripe borders.
